{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuati Security Forces Headquarters''' was one of the facilities of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Orbital Array]] that constructed [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was located in a ring of other installations that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. As indicated by the name, this was the primary staging area for the [[Kuati Security Forces]].
